verdict.rationale: Weaviate is an open-source vector database with a managed cloud offering, so a data-use and model-training privacy policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Self-hosting with local embedding models and multi-tenancy isolation are adjacent deployment and isolation features, not a documented control against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
